title: Constructive Denumerability of Algebraic Numbers
description: Constructive proof that the algebraic numbers are countable, avoiding the full axiom of choice. Uses polynomial countability and FTA for finite roots.

meta.author: Classical (Cantor-style)
meta.assumptions: No axioms or sorries. Core argument uses Mathlib's FTA (Polynomial.setOf_isRoot_finite) and Set.countable_iUnion. 1 True stub (choiceless_note, documentation only).

mathlibDependencies.description: Fundamental theorem of algebra: each nonzero polynomial has finitely many roots
Countable union of countable sets is countable

originalContributions: Constructive proof of algebraic numbers countability
Finite roots per polynomial via FTA

conclusion.summary: Algebraic numbers proved countable without full AC. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
